t: Allah told Prophet Ibrahim to build a house in Makkah, to worship Allah alone.
Allah memerintahkan Nabi Ibrahim membangun rumah di Makkah, untuk menyembah Allah saja.
His son Ismail helped him. Ismail carried the stones, and Ibrahim built the walls.
Putranya, Ismail, membantu. Ismail membawa batu, dan Ibrahim membangun dindingnya.
As they worked, they prayed: "Our Lord, accept this from us!"
Sambil bekerja mereka berdoa: "Ya Tuhan kami, terimalah dari kami!"
That house is the Kaaba. Today we all face it when we pray. Let's help others like Ismail helped his father!
Rumah itu adalah Ka'bah. Kini kita semua menghadapnya saat sholat. Ayo suka membantu seperti Ismail!
Maryam was a very good woman who loved to worship Allah.
Maryam adalah wanita salehah yang senang beribadah kepada Allah.
When baby Isa was about to be born, she rested under a palm tree, tired and alone.
Saat bayi Isa akan lahir, ia beristirahat di bawah pohon kurma, lelah dan sendirian.
Allah told her: "Shake the palm tree, and fresh ripe dates will fall for you."
Allah berfirman: "Goyangkan pohon kurma itu, niscaya buah kurma yang masak akan jatuh untukmu."
Allah always takes care of those who trust Him. Say Alhamdulillah for the food we eat!
Allah selalu menjaga orang yang bertawakal. Ucapkan Alhamdulillah untuk makanan kita!
The king of Egypt had a strange dream about seven fat cows and seven thin cows.
Raja Mesir bermimpi aneh tentang tujuh sapi gemuk dan tujuh sapi kurus.
Allah taught Prophet Yusuf the meaning: seven good years, then seven hungry years.
Allah mengajarkan Nabi Yusuf artinya: tujuh tahun panen, lalu tujuh tahun paceklik.
Yusuf told everyone to plant crops and save grain in the good years.
Yusuf menyuruh semua orang menanam dan menyimpan gandum di tahun-tahun baik.
When the hungry years came, everyone had food. Plan ahead and never waste food!
Saat paceklik datang, semua orang punya makanan. Rencanakan dengan baik dan jangan buang makanan!
The friends of Prophet Isa asked: "Can Allah send us a table of food from the sky?"
Para pengikut Nabi Isa bertanya: "Bisakah Allah menurunkan hidangan dari langit?"
Prophet Isa prayed to Allah for them.
Nabi Isa berdoa kepada Allah untuk mereka.
Allah sent down a table full of food, as a sign and a blessing.
Allah menurunkan hidangan penuh makanan, sebagai tanda dan rahmat.
This story is in Surah Al-Ma'idah, "The Table". Every meal is a gift, so say Alhamdulillah!
Kisah ini ada dalam Surah Al-Ma'idah, "Hidangan". Setiap makanan adalah nikmat, ucapkan Alhamdulillah!
Prophet Nuh called his people to worship Allah for many, many years.
Nabi Nuh mengajak kaumnya menyembah Allah selama bertahun-tahun.
Allah told him to build a big ark, a giant ship, on dry land.
Allah memerintahkannya membuat bahtera besar, kapal raksasa, di daratan.
When the great flood came, Nuh brought the believers and pairs of animals onto the ark.
Saat banjir besar datang, Nuh membawa orang beriman dan hewan berpasangan ke dalam bahtera.
Allah kept them all safe. Be patient and keep doing good, even when it is hard!
Allah menyelamatkan mereka semua. Bersabarlah dan terus berbuat baik, walau sulit!
Prophet Sulaiman was a king. Allah let him understand the animals.
Nabi Sulaiman adalah seorang raja. Allah membuatnya mengerti bahasa binatang.
One day his big army marched through a valley full of ants.
Suatu hari pasukannya yang besar berjalan melewati lembah semut.
A little ant called: "Ants, go into your homes, so you are not stepped on!"
Seekor semut kecil berseru: "Wahai semut, masuklah ke sarangmu agar tidak terinjak!"
Sulaiman smiled and thanked Allah. Be kind to even the smallest creatures!
Sulaiman tersenyum dan bersyukur kepada Allah. Sayangi makhluk sekecil apa pun!
Prophet Yunus left his people and sailed away on a ship.
Nabi Yunus meninggalkan kaumnya dan pergi naik kapal.
A storm came, Yunus fell into the sea, and a big fish swallowed him!
Badai datang, Yunus jatuh ke laut, dan seekor ikan besar menelannya!
In the dark, he prayed: "La ilaha illa anta, subhanaka, inni kuntu minaz-zalimin."
Dalam gelap ia berdoa: "La ilaha illa anta, subhanaka, inni kuntu minaz-zalimin."
Allah heard him and the fish set him free on the shore. Allah always hears our dua!
Allah mendengarnya dan ikan itu mengeluarkannya di pantai. Allah selalu mendengar doa kita!
A giant warrior named Jalut scared everyone in the army.
Seorang prajurit raksasa bernama Jalut membuat semua pasukan takut.
Young Dawud was not afraid. He trusted Allah.
Dawud yang masih muda tidak takut. Ia bertawakal kepada Allah.
With Allah's help, Dawud defeated the giant Jalut.
Dengan pertolongan Allah, Dawud mengalahkan raksasa Jalut.
Allah later made Dawud a prophet and a king. With Allah's help, small can beat big!
Allah kemudian menjadikan Dawud nabi dan raja. Dengan pertolongan Allah, yang kecil bisa menang!
Prophet Muhammad ﷺ and his friend Abu Bakr left Makkah to go to Madinah. This is the Hijrah.
Nabi Muhammad ﷺ dan sahabatnya Abu Bakar pergi dari Makkah ke Madinah. Inilah Hijrah.
People were chasing them, so they hid in the Cave of Thawr on a mountain.
Mereka dikejar, maka mereka bersembunyi di Gua Tsur di atas gunung.
Abu Bakr was worried. The Prophet ﷺ said: "Don't be sad, Allah is with us."
Abu Bakar khawatir. Nabi ﷺ bersabda: "Jangan bersedih, Allah bersama kita."
Allah kept them safe, and they reached Madinah. When you are scared, remember Allah is with you!
Allah melindungi mereka hingga sampai di Madinah. Saat takut, ingat Allah bersamamu!
One night young Ibrahim looked at a shining star. But then the star set and disappeared.
Suatu malam Ibrahim muda melihat bintang bersinar. Lalu bintang itu terbenam dan hilang.
He saw the bright moon. But the moon also went away.
Ia melihat bulan yang terang. Tapi bulan juga menghilang.
He saw the big sun. But even the sun set in the evening.
Ia melihat matahari yang besar. Tapi matahari pun terbenam di sore hari.
Ibrahim said: "I turn to Allah, who created the heavens and the earth!" Allah made everything we see.
Ibrahim berkata: "Aku menghadap Allah, yang menciptakan langit dan bumi!" Allah menciptakan semua yang kita lihat.
Long ago in Egypt, Pharaoh was cruel to the people of Prophet Musa.
Dahulu di Mesir, Firaun berbuat zalim kepada kaum Nabi Musa.
Allah told Musa to lead his people away at night. Pharaoh and his army chased them.
Allah menyuruh Musa membawa kaumnya pergi di malam hari. Firaun dan pasukannya mengejar.
They reached the sea. Allah told Musa to strike the sea with his staff, and it split into a dry path!
Mereka tiba di laut. Allah menyuruh Musa memukul laut dengan tongkatnya, dan laut terbelah menjadi jalan kering!
Musa and his people crossed safely. Allah always helps those who trust Him!
Musa dan kaumnya menyeberang dengan selamat. Allah selalu menolong orang yang bertawakal!
Qarun was so rich that strong men could hardly carry the keys to his treasure.
Qarun sangat kaya, sampai kunci-kunci hartanya berat dipikul orang-orang kuat.
Wise people told him: "Be thankful to Allah and share with others."
Orang-orang bijak menasihatinya: "Bersyukurlah kepada Allah dan berbagilah."
But Qarun was proud. He said: "I got all this by myself!"
Tapi Qarun sombong. Ia berkata: "Semua ini kudapat sendiri!"
Allah took his treasure away. All we have is from Allah, so be thankful and share!
Allah melenyapkan hartanya. Semua yang kita punya dari Allah, maka bersyukur dan berbagilah!
